agent.runner_summary: Runs the OpenAI Agents airline support agent through a simulator adapter that accepts raw string user turns and preserves conversation history internally.

components.when_to_use: Use for failures to retrieve or summarize booking details from a confirmation code.
components.input_guidance: Use kwargs with confirmation_code set to the booking code the user supplies, such as SKY123 or BAY777.
components.output_guidance: Expect either a booking summary string with passenger, route, departure, seat, and status, or the not-found message.

components.when_to_use: Use for mistakes in baggage allowance answers across ticket tiers.
components.input_guidance: Use kwargs with ticket_type set to values such as standard, basic, business, first, or premium.
components.output_guidance: Expect the ticket-specific baggage policy string returned by the tool.

components.when_to_use: Use for failures to validate confirmation codes or report seat-change outcomes.
components.input_guidance: Use kwargs with confirmation_code and requested_seat matching the user request, for example SKY123 and 14C.
components.output_guidance: Expect either a success string naming the updated seat and booking code or the invalid-code message.

log_notes: Agent turns in learning environments should stay as raw user strings; the adapter is responsible for maintaining prior conversation state between turns.
The demo booking table includes valid confirmation codes SKY123 and BAY777; other codes return the booking-not-found or seat-change validation messages.
change_seat mutates in-memory booking state for the remainder of a single simulation run, so use mocks when the scenario should avoid state changes.
learning_env_guidance: For agent simulations, set FixedTurn.content to a plain user message string. Do not wrap the turn in JSON or an internal helper payload.
Use SKY123 or BAY777 when a scenario needs an existing booking. Use another code when the scenario should trigger a not-found path.

Prefer live execution for baggage_policy and lookup_booking because they are deterministic local tools; consider mocking airline_support.agent:change_seat when a scenario should avoid mutating booking state.
Prefer OpenAI when OPENAI_API_KEY is available. If it is not set, the agent falls back to the Anthropic LiteLLM model selected by ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.
